resources.string: LibrePods writes heart-rate averages only after you enable export and grant write access. It never requests access to read your health data.
Minute mode writes one average per minute. Detailed mode writes one average per second.
Turning export off stops accepting new samples, cancels pending work, and discards unsaved samples. You can also revoke access at any time in Health Connect.
Heart-rate records are stored and managed by Health Connect on this device. LibrePods does not upload them or include them in app logs.
Optional and off by default. LibrePods writes heart-rate averages only after write permission is granted and never reads health data.
Write one-second averages instead of one average per minute.
